text:
Sam: quick heads-up — our CI SAST job started failing on the key-rotation pipeline. getting `AccessDenied` when the scanner tries to pull KMS audit logs.
Maya: ugh. which principal is it using? the sast-runner-service? :thinking_face:
Sam: yes. sast-runner-service@infra. It used to read the logs via a cross-account role; looks like RBAC changed during last week’s keystore cleanup.
Jun: I saw alerts. The audit-log bucket shows `GetObject` denied for that service account.
Priya: if we open an exception, we need an auditable change and a short-lived grant. we should avoid a permanent wide role.
Sam: agreed. proposing a time-bound IAM role binding + kms:Decrypt on the audit-key alias only for the scan window. plus a logging tag so we can filter requests.
Maya: sounds good. can we gate that change behind the scan owner and sec review? we don't want to let it slip.
Sam: yeah. plan: 1) create role with conditions (requester = sast-runner-service, resource = audit-key alias, time window = 1 hour) 2) add an entry to the change log 3) run scans. If failure persists, escalate.
Jun: add a requirement to attach the PR number in the assume-role session name so it's traceable. e.g. sessionName = pr-<num>
Priya: also add a suppression comment pattern for false positives so we don't end up whitelisting code. runbook should require evidence for suppression.
Sam: putting a short checklist in the PR description: what logs were accessed, role arn, time window, reviewer (sec).
Maya: can sec-bot help auto-verify the role arn and time window? it could reject if not matching pattern.
sec-bot: automated: I can validate role arn format and presence of `aws:RequestedRegion` condition. ping me when PR is open with tag `#sec-verify`.
OpsOncall: FYI — if we do time-limited grants, monitor for multiple assume-role events from one session within 5m window. that may indicate a loop.
Sam: good call. i'll draft the PR and run the dry-run in staging first. linking the runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sdlc-scan-rbac
Maya: thanks. add the KMS audit log bucket path to the runbook sections. people keep guessing the path.
Priya: one more: record the bumped permissions in the compliance ticket so auditors can see rationale.
Sam: will do. target to land the change today after sec review. small follow-up: if anyone sees the `AccessDenied` logs for other services, drop them here.
Maya: :thumbsup:
Jun: noted. I'll watch for anomalies during the window.
sec-bot: automated: reminder scheduled. I'll post a summary in this thread after the PR merges.
